About PPHF

People to People Health Foundation (PPHF) is a health organization dedicated to transforming lives through locally driven health solutions. PPHF works to improve health and well-being by promoting preventive healthcare, strengthening health systems, and mobilizing communities for sustainable health impact. (www.pphfglobal.org)

About Project Charaka

Project Charaka focuses on telehealth kiosks, community awareness, and mobilization to improve healthcare access. It bridges the gap between healthcare providers and the community through digital health solutions and awareness programs for preventive and promotive healthcare services.

Key Responsibilities

Community Mobilization
Promote NCD screening camps and telehealth kiosk services in villages, schools, and PHCs. Mobilize beneficiaries for consultations. Lead community meetings, school sessions, and awareness rallies.

Training & Awareness
Facilitate training for ASHAs, ANMs, teachers, and local stakeholders on preventive healthcare, lifestyle diseases, and telehealth kiosk usage.

Kiosk Support & Implementation
Ensure smooth daily functioning of telehealth kiosks at assigned PHCs. Support patients and guide staff through tele-consultations. Coordinate troubleshooting with the technical team.

Coordination & Liaisoning
Build strong rapport with PHC/CHC staff, Panchayat members, school authorities, and local leaders. Support alignment with government health programs.

Government Engagement
Support inclusion of Charaka activities in government PIPs and health schemes. Attend block/district health meetings.

Data & Reporting
Track daily footfall, screenings, and consultations. Document success stories and challenges. Submit timely reports to the Program Manager.

Documentation

Take photos and videos pertaining to project including geo tagged images in order to document the progress of the project including testimonials from the field.

Any other activities assigned by line manager.

  • Graduate in any discipline (Social Work / Public Health preferred)
  • 2+ years’ experience in Public Health, Community Health, or NGO/Govt. programs

Role Summary

The Program Coordinator (M&E) will be responsible for providing technical and implementation support to strengthen the Monitoring, Evaluation, and Learning (MEL) components of the Non-Communicable Disease (NCD) program. The position will ensure systematic data collection, analysis, reporting, and learning across all levels of the project in alignment with the Comprehensive Monitoring and Evaluation Plan (CMEP).

Key Responsibilities

  • Program Monitoring & Technical Support

Provide technical and implementation support to strengthen M&E systems for the NCD program at the state level.

  • Lead the implementation and management of monitoring and evaluation activities, including the roll-out of the Comprehensive M&E Plan.
  • Framework & Tools Development

Contribute to the development and finalization of the MEL framework, indicator framework, and data collection plan.

  • Develop M&E tools, templates, and guidelines, and conduct orientation/training sessions for project staff on data collection and reporting processes.
  • Data Collection & Analysis

Coordinate and oversee data collection efforts at state, district, and community levels.

  • Ensure timely preparation of monitoring reports, synthesize data at program level, and provide insights for program improvements.
  • Evaluation & Learning

Monitor progress and results of program activities against set indicators and targets.

Contribute to periodic evaluations, assessments, and reviews of interventions.

  • Support documentation and dissemination of key learnings, best practices, and program results to stakeholders.
  • Capacity Building & Support

Support implementation of NCD population-based screenings, including planning and organizing training programs.

  • Provide ongoing technical guidance, mentoring, and coaching to field staff and partners on M&E practices.
  • Coordination & Partnerships

Work closely with consortium partners, technical teams, and stakeholders at state, district, and community levels to strengthen MEL systems and processes.

  • Maintain strong coordination with the technical team on design, planning, and execution of the comprehensive MEL strategy.
  • Other Responsibilities

Undertake additional tasks assigned by the supervisor, aligned with project needs and organizational priorities.

Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree (Master’s preferred) in Public Health, Social Sciences, Statistics, Development Studies, or related field.
  • Minimum 3–5 years of relevant experience in M&E within public health or development sector programs (experience in NCD programs preferred).
  • Strong knowledge of M&E frameworks, indicator development, and data management systems.
  • Hands-on experience in designing and implementing surveys, data collection tools, and analysis methods.
  • Excellent skills in data synthesis, reporting, and presentation for diverse stakeholders.
  • Proficiency in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint) and statistical/data analysis software (SPSS, STATA, or similar).
  • Strong communication, facilitation, and capacity-building skills.
  • Ability to work collaboratively in a multi-stakeholder environment.

Competency:

  • Analytical thinking and problem-solving.
  • Strong organizational and documentation skills.
  • Attention to detail and commitment to data quality.
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities under tight deadlines.
  • Team player with strong interpersonal skills.

Requirements:

  • A minimum of five years’ experience in an M&E position, implementing M&E activities for development projects.
  • Experience in designing, implementing, and operating project M&E systems from project start to close, including developing data collection tools, overseeing and assessing data quality, and managing beneficiary monitoring and database systems.
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills in English, Hindi & Kannada.
  • Proficiency in word processing, spreadsheets (preferably Microsoft Access and Excel), presentation software (Microsoft PowerPoint), and statistical applications (SPSS, SAS, or STATA).

Application Process

Interested candidates should send a Covering Letter mentioning the job title and location (e.g., Program Coordinator – M&E, Bangalore) in the subject line along with their recent CV as a Word document attachment to career@pphfglobal.org.
